=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Phase 1 step 3 / Files & Modules (scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:423-426, 674-678) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan omits `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh`, which reuses the implement prefix and runs the diagnoser in an isolated sandbox with no `--include` for `agents.rendered.md`.
  WHY: In index mode the diagnoser gets an index pointing at an unmounted file and loses all agents.md context, and `fallback=inline` never fires. Reviewers labelled this MAJOR.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 1, Phase 3 step 7, Risks (scripts/write_opencode_config.sh:153-167, 189-190) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: OpenCode reviewer roles have no `external_directory` permission, so the plan's mount-existence check does not show that `agents.rendered.md` outside the workspace is readable.
  WHY: Reads of the rendered file are rejected, the agents content is lost, and the `inline` fallback never fires. Confidence ranged 3-4; reviewers labelled this MAJOR.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:54-66, 138-151, 221-232 (D4, Approach step 1, Step 7; scripts/assemble_agents.py:387-400, scripts/build_static_context.sh:95) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan names no trusted repo root or `agents.d/` fragment directory for `assemble_agents.py render`, and does not stage `assemble_agents.py` for review.
  WHY: Rendering from the PR checkout folds PR-controlled fragments into the "trusted" file, which D4 forbids. If the assembler is not staged, the render fails and review stays `inline`. Reviewers labelled this MAJOR.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Phase 2 step 6, Phase 3 step 7, Rollout (lines 179-186, 198-232) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Only Phase 1 step 5 passes `STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE` through `env:` (for `clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`). The Phase 2 and Phase 3 workflows get no such pass-through.
  WHY: Repository variables are not auto-exported to shell steps, so the advertised `inline` rollback does not reach those phases. Reviewers labelled this MAJOR.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:234-242 (Phase 4 step 8) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not bound how the begin/end markers are matched when it strips the system-instruction block, so marker text in untrusted dynamic content could remove or leave wrong content.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 2), google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR (confidence 3), and minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave it as a hardening suggestion with risk score 3. Highest severity used.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Phase 2 step 6 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2435-2474) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The heal intake item does not name the two existing include lists (`heal_isolated_args` and `heal_include_paths`) or `AI_ENGINE_INCLUDE_PATHS`.
  WHY: It is unclear whether the new include is added alongside the existing paths. This was a hardening suggestion; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 did not verify the line numbers. Severity is inferred from the hardening framing, not stated by the sources.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: PR description: "Target: under 60 KB of prefix per call."
  expected_change_site: PR description, and docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md (Summary lines 7-8, Goals line 113, Phase 1 Done line 176, size-guard test lines 271-272)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The plan targets 75 KB at lines 7-8, 113, 176-177 and 271-272, with the D3 rationale. The PR description still says 60 KB, so the two disagree. Severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR.
- requirement: `STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE=inline` is a one-step rollback on the affected repo for every phase (Rollout, Phases 2-4)
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md Phase 2 step 6 and Phase 3 step 7; `orchestrate.yml`, `orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml`, `orchestrate_poll.yml`, `validate.yml`, `workflow_failure_heal.yml`, `review_autofix.yml`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: Only Phase 1 step 5 passes the variable through `env:`, and only for `clarify.yml`, `plan.yml` and `implement.yml`. Phase 4's gate reads the same variable and has the same problem.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Phase 1 step 3 / Files & Modules | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan omits `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh`, which copies `./pre_assembled_static.txt` (lines 424-425) and runs in `codex_isolated_exec.sh run --mode read-only --` (line 678) or `claude_run` (lines 693-694) with no `--include`.
  WHY: The diagnoser gets an index pointing at an unmounted file, and `fallback=inline` never fires.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 1, Phase 3 step 7, Risks | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `scripts/write_opencode_config.sh` lines 153-167 define the reviewer permissions with no `external_directory` rule, and the plan only checks that the mount exists.
  WHY: Reads outside the project root may be rejected, and the `inline` fallback would not trigger. The reviewer says this is unconfirmed.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 1 and Phase 3 step 7 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `assemble_agents.py` is not in the staging lists, and the plan gives no trusted `agents.d/` source for the render.
  WHY: Rendering from the PR checkout folds in PR-controlled fragments. Not staging the assembler makes review always fall back to `inline`.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Phase 4 step 8 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The plan does not say how marker text in untrusted dynamic content is kept from matching when the block is stripped.
  WHY: A loose marker match lets untrusted text delete trusted instructions.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: `STATIC_CONTEXT_AGENTS_MODE=inline` is a one-step rollback for every phase.
  Expected change site: Phase 2 step 6 and Phase 3 step 7, passing the variable through `env:` in `orchestrate.yml`, `orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml`, `orchestrate_poll.yml`, `validate.yml`, `workflow_failure_heal.yml` and `review_autofix.yml`, or defaulting it in the scripts.
  Evidence of absence: Only Phase 1 step 5 passes the variable through `env:`, and only for `clarify.yml`, `plan.yml` and `implement.yml`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR description "Target: under 60 KB of prefix per call."
  Expected change site: PR description.
  Evidence of absence: The plan consistently says 75 KB, per D3. The PR description was not updated.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

Name both include lists (`heal_isolated_args` at about lines 2435-2440, `heal_include_paths` at about lines 2458-2464). The line numbers are unverified. Estimated lines changed: 1. === FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:234-242 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Stripping the system-instruction block by markers is vulnerable to untrusted marker text in the dynamic prompt content.
  WHY: An injected end marker could end the strip early and leave untrusted instructions in the prompt.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:54-66 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan does not specify the fragment directory or repo root for `assemble_agents.py render`. Running `--repo-root .` in the PR checkout folds in PR-controlled fragments.
  WHY: PR-controlled fragments end up in the trusted file, which D4 forbids.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:198-201 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan promises an `inline` rollback but does not pass the repository variable to the Phase 2 and 3 workflows' scripts.
  WHY: Repository variables are not auto-exported, so later phases stay in `index` mode.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:198-201 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan misses `scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh`, which has no `--include` or `AI_ENGINE_INCLUDE_PATHS` setup.
  WHY: The diagnoser gets an index pointing at a non-existent file and no `fallback=inline` log.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:291-294 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The mount check only verifies that the path exists. The OpenCode reviewer roles lack an `external_directory` rule in `scripts/write_opencode_config.sh`.
  WHY: Reads outside `/source` are rejected and the `inline` fallback never fires.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR description "Target: under 60 KB of prefix per call."
  Expected change site: docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md (Summary, Goals) and the PR description.
  Evidence of absence: The plan sets 75 KB at lines 7-8, 113, 176-177 and 271-272, while the PR description stays at 60 KB.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/write_opencode_config.sh:153-189 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The OpenCode permission blocks have no `external_directory` allow rule, and `agents.rendered.md` sits under `${RUNTIME_DIR}/static-context/`, outside `/source`.
  WHY: OpenCode rejects the read and the model loses the content. The mount-existence check passes, so `fallback=inline` never fires.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:54-66, 138, 222-231 (D4, Approach step 1, Step 7) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan never says how `build_agents_index.py` points `--repo-root` at the trusted support copy. The existing builders render with `--repo-root .` (`build_static_context.sh:95`, `orchestrate.yml:682`, `orchestrate_clarify_respond.yml:904`, `orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1470`, `validate_process.sh:4159`), and `assemble_agents.py` is not in the staged-support entries.
  WHY: A PR that adds an `agents.d/` fragment changes the rules applied to its own review.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Step 6 (207-219), Files & Modules (253-258); scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:423-426, 674-678 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The unnamed script copies `./pre_assembled_static.txt` and runs the diagnose codex call with no `--include` and no `AI_ENGINE_INCLUDE_PATHS`.
  WHY: Every codex-fallback diagnose run silently loses agents.md, with no `fallback=inline` log.
- docs/plans/unattended-prompt-diet-plan.md:Approach step 3 (152-157), Steps 5-7 (204-231) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only Phase 1 passes the variable through `env:`. The Phase 2 and Phase 3 workflows get no pass-through.
  WHY: The advertised `inline` rollback never reaches those phases.
- TASK_GAP: Requirem
